name: Mystical Elf
ability: A delicate elf that lacks offense, but has a terrific defense backed by mystical power.

name: Feral Imp
ability: A playful little fiend that lurks in the dark, waiting to attack an unwary enemy.

name: Winged Dragon, Guardian of the Fortress #1
ability: A dragon commonly found guarding mountain fortresses. Its signature attack is a sweeping dive from out of the blue.

name: Beaver Warrior
ability: What this creature lacks in size it makes up for in defense when battling in the prairie.

name: Dark Magician
ability: ''The ultimate wizard in terms of attack and defense.''

name: Gaia The Fierce Knight
ability: ''A knight whose horse travels faster than the wind. His battle-charge is a force to be reckoned with.''

name: Curse of Dragon
ability: A wicked dragon that taps into dark forces to execute a powerful attack.

name: Celtic Guardian
ability: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

name: Mammoth Graveyard
ability: A mammoth that protects the graves of its pack and is absolutely merciless when facing grave-robbers.

name: Great White
ability: A giant white shark with razor-sharp teeth.

name: Silver Fang
ability: A snow wolf that's beautiful to the eye, but absolutely vicious in battle.

name: Giant Soldier of Stone
ability: A giant warrior made of stone. A punch from this creature has earth-shaking results.

name: Dragon Zombie
ability: A dragon revived by sorcery. Its breath is highly corrosive.

name: Doma The Angel of Silence
ability: This fairy rules over the end of existence.

name: Ansatsu
ability: A silent and deadly warrior specializing in assassinations.

name: Witty Phantom
ability: Dressed in a night-black tuxedo, this creature presides over the darkness.

name: Claw Reacher
ability: Stretching arms and razor-sharp claws make this monster a formidable opponent.

name: Mystic Clown
ability: Nothing can stop the mad attack of this powerful creature.

name: Sword of Dark Destruction
ability: Equip only to a DARK monster. It gains 400 ATK and loses 200 DEF.

name: Book of Secret Arts
ability: A Spellcaster-Type monster equipped with this card increases its ATK and DEF by 300 points.

name: Dark Hole
ability: Destroy all monsters on the field.

name: Dian Keto the Cure Master
ability: Increase your Life Points by 1000 points.

name: Ancient Elf
ability: This elf is rumored to have lived for thousands of years. He leads an army of spirits against his enemies.

name: Magical Ghost
ability: This creature casts a spell of terror and confusion just before attacking its enemies.

name: Fissure
ability: Destroy the 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that has the lowest ATK (your choice, if tied).

name: Trap Hole
ability: When your opponent Normal or Flip Summons 1 monster with 1000 or more ATK: Target that monster; destroy that target.

name: Two-Pronged Attack
ability: Select and destroy 2 of your monsters and 1 of your opponent's monsters.

name: De-Spell
ability: Target 1 face-up Spell, or 1 Set Spell/Trap, on the field; destroy that target if it is a Spell. (If the target is Set, reveal it.)

name: Monster Reborn
ability: Target 1 monster in either GY; Special Summon it.

name: Reinforcements
ability: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; it gains 500 ATK until the end of this turn.

name: Change of Heart
ability: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; take control of it until the End Phase.

name: The Stern Mystic
ability: FLIP: Reveal all face-down cards on the field (Flip Effects are not activated), then return them to their original positions.

name: Wall of Illusion
ability: If this card is attacked by a monster, after damage calculation: Return that monster to the hand.

name: Neo the Magic Swordsman
ability: A dimensional drifter who not only practices sorcery, but is also a sword and martial arts master.

name: Baron of the Fiend Sword
ability: An aristocrat who wields a sword possessed by a malicious spirit that preys on the weak.

name: Man-Eating Treasure Chest
ability: A monster disguised as a treasure chest that is known to attack the unwary adventurer.

name: Sorcerer of the Doomed
ability: A slave of the dark arts, this sorcerer is a master of life-extinguishing spells.

name: Last Will
ability: If a monster on your side of the field was sent to your Graveyard this turn, you can Special Summon 1 monster with an ATK of 1500 points or less from your Deck once during this turn. Then shuffle your Deck.

name: Waboku
ability: You take no battle damage from your opponent's monsters this turn. Your monsters cannot be destroyed by battle this turn.

name: Soul Exchange
ability: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; this turn, if you Tribute a monster, you must Tribute that target, as if you controlled it. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this card.

name: Card Destruction
ability: Both players discard as many cards as possible from their hands, then each player draws the same number of cards they discarded.

name: Trap Master
ability: FLIP: Select 1 Trap Card on the field and destroy it. If the selected card is Set, pick up and see the card. If it is a Trap Card, it is destroyed. If it is a Spell Card, return it to its original position.

name: Dragon Capture Jar
ability: Change all face-up Dragon-Type monsters on the field to Defense Position, also they cannot change their battle positions.

name: Yami
ability: All Fiend and Spellcaster monsters on the field gain 200 ATK/DEF, also all Fairy monsters on the field lose 200 ATK/DEF.

name: Man-Eater Bug
ability: FLIP: Target 1 monster on the field; destroy it.

name: Reverse Trap
ability: Until the End Phase, all effects that add or subtract ATK or DEF are reversed. (Additions now subtract, and subtractions now add, instead. Multiplications and divisions, including halving/doubling, are not affected.)

name: Remove Trap
ability: Select 1 face-up Trap Card on the field and destroy it.

name: Castle Walls
ability: Increase the DEF of 1 face-up monster on the field by 500 points until the end of this turn.

name: Ultimate Offering
ability: During your Main Phase or your opponent's Battle Phase: You can pay 500 Life Points; immediately after this effect resolves, Normal Summon/Set 1 monster.
